profiles.name: Leroy4522
profiles.profile: This bag lives and dies by the same ugly movie: the tee ball shows up, then the irons kick the door in and steal the wallets. The weird part is the one clean window at the par-3 spot, where the short game actually dragged him back to respectability for a minute before the rest of the game remembered it was still a hostage situation. Four completed starts in a row have basically said the same thing with different furniture: enough scraps to avoid total embarrassment, but way too many bogeys and doubles for a guy trying to act like the card belongs to him.
